title: Recuperação de Pontos de Stamina — p. 100
scopeLimits: This batch covers only step A and its explanatory paragraph in the Refresh Phase on page 100.
The bold step heading and three-line body are separate source-backed typographic units, preserving the original hierarchy and rich emphasis.
Original OptimaLTStd 9 pt styles, source geometry, and frames are preserved.

Stamina Points → Pontos de Stamina is glossary-approved; retain the abbreviation SP. Stamina Recovery Bar → Barra de Recuperação de Stamina is a local candidate aligned with p.73, not a globally approved compound. The English-language sheet/component itself remains unchanged.

note: Both source-backed units were rendered together. Copyfit V3 measured the heading 1→1 EXACT and the body 3→3 EXACT at 100% and 200%, preserving rich emphasis and source fonts. Stamina Points → Pontos de Stamina follows the approved glossary; the translated reference to Stamina Recovery Bar remains a local candidate. The active candidate has not replaced the existing approved Payload text.

criticalReview.finding: The heading preserves bold hierarchy and the glossary-approved form Pontos de Stamina; the body preserves both bold SP instances and the bold A: Barra de Recuperação de Stamina reference. The latter remains a local terminology candidate, not a global approval. The body remains three lines and separate from the IMPORTANT notice and step B, without visible collision at 100% or 200%. Existing approved Payload text remains unchanged.
